title: Terminator 3: Rise Of The Machines
desc: The most advanced Terminator unit ever arrives to ensure the rise of the machines. It is up to the T-850 to avert this calamity.

title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
desc: Peter Parker grapples with his dual identity as a teenager and the burgeoning superhero, Spider-Man, balancing the extraordinary with the ordinary challenges of youth.

title: Welcome To The Jungle
desc: A bounty hunter heads to the Amazon to square a debt and teams up with a bad guy in the search for treasure.

title: Anacondas: The Hunt For The Blood Orchid
desc: Searching feral jungles for orchids which contain youth serum scientists find anacondas who've eaten them - bigger smarter more lethal than ever.

title: Kraven The Hunter
desc: Kraven, driven by vengeance and shaped by his father's cruelty, becomes the world's most feared hunter. His journey blurs the line between justice and obsession as he seeks redemption.

title: Escape Room: Tournament of Champions
desc: Six people are captured in a perilous game of escape rooms. To survive, they must team up with two original survivors, but as the rounds go, they wonder if this is a game they've been through before.

title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
desc: A single mother inherits a farmhouse and uncovers her family's connection to the legendary Ghostbusters, revealing a supernatural legacy.

title: Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire
desc: The original Ghostbusters reunite with a new team to battle a powerful, death-chilling god threatening the world.

title: The Water Horse
desc: During WWII, Angus finds a mysterious egg that hatches a water horse. He protects the growing creature from soldiers and danger, forming a deep bond in this magical adventure.

title: Morbius
desc: Driven by a rare blood disorder, Dr. Morbius takes a desperate risk to save others, unknowingly unleashing a dark force within himself.

title: After Earth
desc: General Cypher and his son crashland on Earth 1000 years after cataclysmic events forced humanity to abandon Earth for a new planet.

title: Lake Placid vs. Anaconda
desc: A town sheriff has to find a way to kill a gigantic crocodile and anaconda before they destroy the whole town.
